theorem.statement: On the exact flat PG spatial collar, if the reduced source-side bulk operator is Laplace-type on the coexact carrier, then after fixing the Euclidean first jet the only remaining Ashtekar-Barbero corrections enter as bounded shell-blind endomorphisms or scalar factors in the square-root symbol. Consequently sigma_ell^IO = (ell+1) + O((ell+1)^(-1)). In particular, O(1) shell deformations are excluded.
theorem.mechanism: For shell-blind endomorphism eigenvalue mu^2, the DtN shell law takes the flat-collar form sigma_ell(mu^2) = sqrt(ell(ell+1)+1/4+mu^2) + 1/2, so sigma_ell(mu^2) - (ell+1) = mu^2 / (sqrt(ell(ell+1)+1/4+mu^2) + ell + 1/2) = O(1/ell).
